title: Week Summary: Security, Robustness, and Responsible AI

concepts.name: Adversarial example
concepts.description: An input intentionally crafted or modified to cause a model to make an incorrect prediction.

concepts.name: Model robustness
concepts.description: A model’s ability to maintain acceptable behavior under noise, shifts, attacks, or unusual inputs.

concepts.name: Data poisoning
concepts.description: An attack where malicious or corrupted data is inserted into training data to influence model behavior.

concepts.name: Model extraction
concepts.description: An attack that attempts to copy or approximate a model by querying it and observing outputs.

concepts.name: Fairness
concepts.description: The study and practice of reducing unjust or harmful disparities in model behavior across groups.

concepts.name: Explainability
concepts.description: The ability to describe why a model produced an output in terms understandable to stakeholders.

concepts.name: Model card
concepts.description: A structured document describing a model’s intended use, evaluation, limitations, and ethical considerations.

concepts.name: Risk assessment
concepts.description: The process of identifying, estimating, and prioritizing possible harms or failures.
